integrity: The all-parameter mixed moment and leaf-event formulas follow from conditional recurrences and finite telescoping; an independent exhaustive finite checker verifies orders two through nine. Finite enumeration does not certify the unbounded theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns uniformly attached birth-labelled recursive trees. It does not extend to general recursive-growth models or assert independence of distinct descendant sizes. Classical one-label descendant-size distributions and total path-length variance are not presented as new; historical implicit coverage of the mixed-moment property remains possible.
title: Pairwise orthogonality without independence in random recursive-tree descendant sizes
